title: A level 5 game master's live gold, heal and potion changes reach its client
notes: The run makes its account a game master and seeds a level 5 Fire wizard with 900 experience and a character_stats
row holding 1234 gold, 300 health and 10 mana, below the 503 health and 24 mana its school's level 5 row gives.
The game server builds the wizard's stats from that row and the level tables it extracted from the install itself,
logs what it put in the wizard's WizGameStats, and sends them in the wizard's own object in MSG_LOGINCOMPLETE.
The HUD and backpack are shot before and after .character gold 500 changes gold live without a relog.
The run sets mana to 5 and potion capacity to 2, uses a potion at Potion.RestoreFraction 0.1, changes the live
setting to 0.2 before the next use, then uses .character heal to fill health with DisplayDiff=1.
The character stats screen is opened with C, the key the client's own InputBindings.xml gives ToggleCharStats.
The rest follows enter-world: the chatter the client sends entering the world is answered or allowed, and the
wizard must still be connected at the next keepalive.
Opening the backpack sends MSG_PLAYERWIZBANG, which asks the server to show other players the icon over the wizard's head;
that waits for the milestones that show other players, so the run allows it.
server_log_allowed: character_create_school holds no school, so no wizard can be created until it does
realmlist holds no realm, so no player can be sent to a gameserver until one is added

steps.name: make the account a game master
steps.pattern: Security level of \S+ set to 2

steps.name: the client brings its renderer up
steps.pattern: About to initialize graphical client\.

steps.name: the login window is on the screen
log in
the server decodes the authentication message field by field
steps.pattern: sent MSG_USER_AUTHEN_V3: version (W\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+), revision \S+, data revision \S+, locale \S+, machine [0-9A-F]+,

steps.name: the server accepts the password
steps.pattern: authenticated as {user} \(id \d+\)

steps.name: the client is admitted
steps.pattern: The LoginServer has admitted the user

steps.name: the server lists the wizard the run made
steps.pattern: listed (\d+) character\(s\) of account \d+

steps.name: the character selection scene loads
steps.pattern: WizardCharacterSelect: The scene has been loaded successfully\.

steps.name: the character selection screen is on the screen
the wizard on the character selection screen
press play

until.pattern: sent account \d+ with wizard (\d+) to realm

steps.name: the game server spends the key
steps.pattern: Session \d+ attached: account \d+ with wizard (\d+)

steps.name: the game server sends the wizard its object
steps.pattern: put wizard \d+ in (\S+) instance \d+ at .* and sent its \d+-byte object

steps.name: the client loading the zone
the client loads the zone and the wizard stands in it
steps.pattern: loaded (\S+), and wizard \d+ stands in the world

steps.name: the wizard standing in Ravenwood
the game server answers the timed access passes
steps.pattern: Session \d+ asked for its timed access passes and was told it has none

steps.name: the game server answers the subscriber-only items
steps.pattern: Session \d+ asked which items only subscribers may use and was told none

steps.name: the game server takes the end of shopping
steps.pattern: Session \d+ is done shopping, transaction \d+

steps.name: the game server takes the screen the client runs at
steps.pattern: Session \d+ runs its client at (\d+x\d+)

steps.name: the wizard enters at level 5
steps.pattern: put wizard \d+ in \S+ instance .* level (\d+) with

steps.name: the wizard enters with its stored health
steps.pattern: level \d+ with (\d+) of \d+ health

steps.name: its health is out of its school's level 5 maximum
steps.pattern: with \d+ of (\d+) health

steps.name: the wizard enters with its stored mana
steps.pattern: health and (\d+) of \d+ mana

steps.name: its mana is out of its school's level 5 maximum
steps.pattern: health and \d+ of (\d+) mana

steps.name: the HUD shows the stored health and mana
open the backpack
the backpack shows the stored gold
close the backpack before viewing stored character stats
open the character stats before live changes
the character stats show the stored level and school
close the stored character stats
reopen the backpack for live gold
open the chat line to type .character gold 500
take out the slash before .character gold 500
type .character gold 500
send .character gold 500
the game master changes gold live
steps.pattern: account \d+ with wizard {wizard_guid} ran character gold 500, which worked

steps.name: the backpack shows live gold
close the backpack
set the first potion restore fraction
steps.command: settings set Potion.RestoreFraction 0.1 the 8.01 potion check
steps.pattern: Potion\.RestoreFraction is now 0\.1

steps.name: open the chat line to type .character mana 5
take out the slash before .character mana 5
type .character mana 5
send .character mana 5
the game master lowers mana
steps.pattern: account \d+ with wizard {wizard_guid} ran character mana 5, which worked

steps.name: open the chat line to type .character potion 2
take out the slash before .character potion 2
type .character potion 2
send .character potion 2
the game master fills two potion charges
steps.pattern: account \d+ with wizard {wizard_guid} ran character potion 2, which worked

steps.name: the HUD shows two filled potion charges
use the first potion
the first potion restores health
steps.pattern: MSG_UpdateHealth: Updating health globe \(new health: 350, new health max: 503\)

steps.name: the first potion restores health and mana and empties one charge
change the restore fraction while the game server stays up
steps.command: settings set Potion.RestoreFraction 0.2 the 8.01 live-setting check
steps.pattern: Potion\.RestoreFraction is now 0\.2

steps.name: use the second potion at the new restore fraction
the second potion uses the new health restore fraction
steps.pattern: MSG_UpdateHealth: Updating health globe \(new health: 451, new health max: 503\)

steps.name: the second potion applies the new fraction and empties the last charge
open the chat line to type .character heal
take out the slash before .character heal
type .character heal
send .character heal
the game master heals the wizard
steps.pattern: account \d+ with wizard {wizard_guid} ran character heal, which worked

steps.name: the health globe shows the live heal
open the character stats
the character stats show the level and school after live changes
close the character stats
the wizard is still connected at the next keepalive
steps.pattern: Session \d+ keepalive from the client

steps.name: the wizard still standing
the client loaded every object the server sent
steps.pattern: LoadObject Failed|LoadObject tried to read more data
